allowed_conclusion: If SUPPORTED: a scoped better-solver statement for triangle_free_host_v1 hosts from the e1d calibrated settings on that panel only, against the five registered baselines including an exact MILP at four times the candidate budget. Not better-improver, transfer, novelty, or any statement about other families or other exact methods.

baselines.comparator: the strongest of the five registered baselines on the custodian SELECT panel (custodian.select_comparator under rule e1-hard-v3-draft)
baselines.exact_baseline_note: milp-highs-v1 is HiGHS through the pinned scipy, one core, best incumbent at its time limit; at 2.0 s it has four times the candidate search budget
baselines.not_a_competitor: the generated-rows reference (LP over Lean-checked rows, rounding of its own LP, SAT/DRAT) is evaluator ground truth; it solves these hosts exactly in about 20 s of wall time, which the claim must state

capability_changes: Candidate: B18 W10 representation grammar (cross_2) with greedy repair, unchanged from E1. Evaluator: registry-v2 exact baselines and the generated-rows reference over Lean-checked rows (B20_R39/R42 wiring, evaluation request v5); every arm in the OCI sandbox through the trusted runners.
exact_claim: The frozen representation-and-repair candidate (descriptor f4c7f4b0e5ced594, cut representation cross_2, 0.5 CPU s of search) scores more edges than the strongest of five registered baselines (the three time-matched fixed DSL programs at 0.5 CPU s, and the exact MILP milp-highs-v1 at 0.5 and at 2.0 CPU s), selected by the custodian on its private SELECT panel, on a custodian-held CONFIRM panel of triangle_free_host_v1 hosts drawn from the e1d study calibration (rule e1-hard-v3-draft, record SHA-256 a4673c748ec23a89, settings planted_cluster {'n': 38, 'p_in': 0.8, 'p_out': 0.07}, planted_cluster {'n': 40, 'p_in': 0.8, 'p_out': 0.06}, planted_cluster {'n': 40, 'p_in': 0.7, 'p_out': 0.06}), with optima certified by the generated-rows reference (generated-rows-v1, theory package SHA-256 21b296d01c7d46ab), by at least the minimum useful effect, under the registered analysis.
exposure_policy: Custodian-built exposure registry; isomorphism and near-duplicate screening against every DEV panel named in the evidence and every host the builder generated (handoff/e1d/exposure_hosts_all_part_*.json); a SELECT or CONFIRM panel is retired after its one use.
permissible_information: The candidate sees only the candidate view (domain, n, edges). Development used public DEV panels only. SELECT and CONFIRM are drawn and held by the custodian.
raw_evidence_custody: Custodian private evidence store; the judge recomputes the analysis; the custodian publishes a signed registration log.
rejection_criteria: Any decision-record or plan check failing; an evaluator that cannot run the candidate; registration beyond the declared family size; an INVALID or NOT_SUPPORTED outcome. A comparator not selected by the custodian on its SELECT panel. A panel not drawn from the e1d study calibration named in the claim. A reference other than the route the request names.

sample_size_justification.model: headroom-limited integer improvements over centred DEV pilot differences
sample_size_justification.note: pilot effect sizes are reported but never used to set the effect; only spread and headroom are

total_budget.charge: every attempt, retry, timeout and failure
total_budget.equal_accounting: one sandbox, one profile, cgroup CPU per arm
